name: io.github.har5h98/crm-lifecycle-ops
title: CRM Lifecycle Ops
description: Pre-send QA for Braze, Klaviyo and Iterable: email, SMS, push and in-app checks. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_BRAZE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Braze REST API key (read-only permissions). Leave unset to skip Braze.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_BRAZE_REST_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Braze REST endpoint for your instance, e.g. https://rest.iad-01.braze.com

environmentVariables.name: CLO_BRAZE_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: A label for the Braze workspace this key belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_KLAVIYO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Klaviyo private API key (read-only scopes). Leave unset to skip Klaviyo.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_KLAVIYO_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: A label for the Klaviyo account this key belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_ITERABLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Iterable server-side API key (read-only). Leave unset to skip Iterable.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_ITERABLE_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Iterable data center: us or eu.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_ITERABLE_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: A label for the Iterable project this key belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_RULES
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a shared house-rules file so a whole team is checked the same way.

environmentVariables.name: CLO_TEAM_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared folder for the team usage report (check counts only, no message content).
